prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Houston, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1120; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just get to what happened, but fine. I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.

Q: Understood. Can you describe where you were and what you were doing right before the impact?

A: I was in Houston, heading down a main road and turning left into a shopping center driveway. I had my signal on and I was going slowly because of the traffic coming the other way.

Q: When you began your turn, what did you see in the oncoming lanes?

A: There was a car coming toward me. I thought I had enough room, but the other vehicle came in faster than I expected and clipped the front of my car.

Q: Did you have any warning before the contact, like a horn or brakes?

A: I heard a horn just before it hit. I tried to brake but there wasn't time.

Q: Were you wearing a seatbelt, and did the airbags deploy?

A: Yes, I had my seatbelt on. The airbags did not go off, but the steering wheel jerked hard and I twisted my body.

Q: Can you tell me about any injuries you have noticed since the collision?

A: My left knee took the worst of it. It hit the dashboard area and it's swollen and painful when I put weight on it. I went to get it checked out a few hours later.

Q: Have you been seen by a medical provider for the knee, and are you currently receiving treatment?

A: Yes, I was seen and they gave me a referral for imaging. I'm scheduled for follow-up appointments and I'm using a brace for now.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was driving carefully and I'd like this resolved so I can get back to work.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
